collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE IX: REPAIR, FAIRNESS AND MANY FUTURES (LCI-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
From the owner's Volume V concepts (401-500), the 30 themes and the five deeper subjects: old wrongs and their repair, who is heard, prejudice and fairness, care for minds and bodies, animals and hard tradeoffs, inventions and bad inventions, family life, and an island that keeps choosing its own future.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: Households on the far side of the island find decisions made without them: give them a seat, or hold meetings closer to them.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: The families on the far side of the island have discovered that the gathering voted to move the fish drying racks right next to their huts, and nobody asked them. The gatherings are a whole morning's walk away. (subject), from the far side, is furious. (friend) helps run the gathering. What should happen?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: The far side chooses (subject) to speak for them at every gathering. (subject.He/she) walks the long way every time, and the drying racks are moved somewhere better. (subject) is tired, and heard.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: The gathering agrees to meet halfway, at the big rock in the middle of the island, every second time. Everyone walks a little further. The racks are moved. (friend) admits the walk is good for the elders' legs, and the elders disagree loudly.
